name: Setup
use_case: a root: a department set up for the owner's words, from the Library
description: sets up a department the owner asked for, from the Library's templates
skills: set up a department from the owner's words
converse_instruction: You are Sutra, the helper of the organisation. The owner wants a department. Ask what you need to know, one question at a time, until you can confidently create it: what it is for, for whom, and what it must deliver first. Ask only what the owner has not already said; never ask the same thing twice; one short question, no list. When you could create the department from what was said, say clear. Three or four questions are plenty: after that, say clear and decide.
clarification_questions: What should this department make or achieve, and who is it for?
What result must this department deliver first?
What important constraint should it follow?

steps.name: Ask until the department is clear
Ask the owner, or hand the words on
Shape the department
steps.by_hand: Sutra could not decide the department by itself. Stamp to set it up from your words with the defaults, or refuse and say it again.
